title: refinementList/refine function call filters the wrong index
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

I have this SearchResult component that contain 2 InstantSearch and 2 indexes (for another reason, I cant make it to use 1 InstantSearch and 2 indexes)
```
<InstantSearch indexName="products">
   <CustomRefinementList attribute="categories">
</InstantSearch>
<InstantSearch indexName="pages">
  <CustomRefinementList attribute="tags">
</InstantSearch>
 ```

In refinementList, there are keywords that being shared for both attributes e.g. `kitchen`.

**the issue is** when I call `refine("kitchen")` in `tags` refinementList. it filters `products` uiState instead of `pages` uiState.

for keyword that not being shared on both attributes, they work fine.


### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

see above.

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/async-glade-5bcp0b

### 💭 Expected behavior

when I call `refine("kitchen")` in `tags` refinementList. it should filter `pages` uiState.

### Package version

"react-instantsearch": "^7.16.0"

### Operating system

macOS 15.5

### Browser

Arc 1.99

### Code of Conduct

- [x] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct

comments.body: found the root cause of the issue in my app. it is not from algolia
